notes.title: Patch Update 8.03
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259940/3a9ef1aaa49fe4c5cdd1be09173a745a81481152.png[/img]

[b]Patch Update 8.03 - Stable[/b]
[list]
[*] Single Player Mode: New mission available to score points on 2 specific maps (Daily Selection).
[*] UI Interface (MOBILE): Reduced size of main menu elements for better adaptation to new devices.
[*] Graphics: 60 FPS now enabled by default.
[*] Chat: Victory messages in battles now show details about critical cuts.
[*] Gameplay: Fixed incorrect movement when using Disbicar with Auto descarregar enabled.
[*] Gameplay: Slightly increased pull time when using Disbicar with Auto descarregar.
[*] Gameplay: Auto descarregar now stays active in the next match if you remain in the same scene or room.
[*] Gameplay: Improved line movement effect when using the drop movement.
[*] Gameplay: Improved the cut line effect connected to the player.
[*] In-Game Purchase API (MOBILE): Better purchase detection to show errors more clearly and track delayed verifications more efficiently.
[*] Optimization in linecollision calculation.
[*] Others: Minor general improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Update – Version 8.00 🚀
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259940/3a9ef1aaa49fe4c5cdd1be09173a745a81481152.png[/img]
This update focuses on bug fixes, increased security, and improved battle experience in both Single Player and Online modes.

🆕 New:

[list]
[*] New Prime Level 2
[*] New NASA (pass) and ZETTA (Prime Level 2) lines
[*] New Room Mode (Singleplayer & Multiplayer): Now you can set a maximum score (automatic for bots); the first player to reach that score wins.
[*] New info: Critical hit type shown after winning a battle.
[*] New ARRAIA kites!
[*] New type of tail for Prime Level 2
[*] DLC PASE YT: New prices in the line market: 4,500 and 5,000 Dimas.
[*] DLC PASE YT: Earn more pase points: by trimming, cutting, and winning tournaments!
[/list]

🛠️ Improvements & Fixes:

[list]
[*] Multiplayer & Festival: Tournament interval in Festival reduced: START 45 → 30 min. (wait winner 5 → 3 min.)
[*] Multiplayer: Line durability synchronization adjusted; tweaks applied for better accuracy in special situations like X-angle cuts and other critical cases.
[*] Kite in battle: The kite now spins at the exact point of line collision for a more realistic look.
[*] Improved tail physics: More realism and control in your maneuvers!
[*] Trimmed kite animations: Now smoother and more fluid.
[*] Purchase system fix on Android: Duplicate purchases prevented.
[*] Optimized speed for large kites: Now faster and more responsive.
[*] PC Version: Zoom enabled while flying a kite.
[*] PC Version: Kite movement detection improved in Camera mode for smoother gameplay.
[*] More challenging bots for advanced players: Bot difficulty adjusted to offer more intense matches for high-level players.
[*] Ads: Alternative ads only appear after losing the first battle.
[*] Internal game improvements: Better performance and overall stability.
[*] EXP gain improved in all situations.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 7.90 Changes
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45259940/3a9ef1aaa49fe4c5cdd1be09173a745a81481152.png[/img]

This patch is designed to enhance the multiplayer gameplay experience and improve tournament visibility. We've implemented several fixes and new features to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable experience for all players.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented access to offline mode.
[*] Resolved an issue with the DISBICAR movement of the kite when pressed repeatedly.
[*] Added a new chat filter to censor WhatsApp numbers, reducing risks associated with scams and other potential issues.
[*] Included new details to simplify and improve the player reporting process.
[*] Enhanced the accuracy of remote kite movements in online mode, ensuring smoother and more precise control.
[*] Tournaments now appear in the public room list, making them more accessible to players.
[*] Tournaments no longer kick players upon completion; instead, they will restart automatically to allow for new matches.
[*] Smoothed kite movements when using a tail (rabiola); movements will now feel more controlled, while kites without a tail will exhibit rougher motion.
[*] Other minor changes and optimizations to improve overall gameplay.
[/list]

tags.bug: Fixed a bug that prevented access to offline mode.
Resolved an issue with the DISBICAR movement of the kite when pressed repeatedly.

tags.feature: Added a new chat filter to censor WhatsApp numbers, reducing risks associated with scams and other potential issues.
Included new details to simplify and improve the player reporting process.
Enhanced the accuracy of remote kite movements in online mode, ensuring smoother and more precise control.
Tournaments now appear in the public room list, making them more accessible to players.
Tournaments no longer kick players upon completion; instead, they will restart automatically to allow for new matches.

notes.title: Update 7.88 - PC and Mobile Crossover Update
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45259940/3a9ef1aaa49fe4c5cdd1be09173a745a81481152.png[/img]

This update focuses on the game's launch on Steam and improvements to mechanics across all platforms.

[h3]New Content[/h3]
Season 2 Ranking: Begins with a reset of players' Division scores.
Lines: New line added for Ranked Division 1 and Member Pass holders.
Player: Tournament wins are now tracked.
House Map: Expanded boundaries for freer player movement.
Division Ranking Points:
Cutting an opponent: +1.
Winning a tournament: +20.
Special cuts: Double/Triple/Quad/Penta/Hexa +2 each.
Member Pass Points: Cutting an opponent: +1.
Fixes and Improvements

[h3]Graphics:[/h3]
Enhanced kite movement for increased realism.
Improved first-person perspective, now the default view.
Refined line movement during gameplay.

[h3]UI:[/h3]
Line HP bar enabled by default.
Login screen integrated with the main menu.

[h3]Security:[/h3]
Limited purple line sales for users without accounts.
Added protection for critical variables.

[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
Nerfed HP recovery for the most powerful lines, especially "discharge" types.
Unlimited backpack upgrades available regardless of VIP or Pass status.
Binoculars added for spotting cut kites.
Member Pass: First 5 lines are free for pass holders.

[h3]Exclusive for PC & Demo:[/h3]
New buttons: Quick Discharge, Bisbicar, and Auto Discharge.
Improved kite handling mechanics.
Demo progress transfers to the full game upon purchase.
